description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the model size, denoted as 'M', and the perplexity of three different language models. The x-axis, labeled 'M', is a linear scale ranging from 3 to 8, with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis, labeled 'Perplexity', is also a linear scale ranging from 20.0 to 40.0, with tick labels at every 10.0 interval. The plot features three lines, each representing a different language model. The green line, marked with a circle and a solid line, represents the "LLMaI-7B" model, which shows a steady increase in perplexity as the model size increases. The blue line, marked with a triangle and a solid line, represents the "LLMaI-13B" model, which also shows an increase in perplexity but at a higher perplexity level than the "LLMaI-7B" model. The orange line, marked with a star and a solid line, represents the "Vicuna-7B" model, which exhibits a more gradual increase in perplexity compared to the other two models. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of the changes in perplexity.
